findings.subject: load-more-trigger
findings.summary: In dark mode the failed-state Retry label (and its icon) is drawn in --a63-action-danger, which stays danger-600 in dark and gives about 2.8-2.95:1 on dark surfaces, below the 4.5:1 WCAG 1.4.3 needs for text.
findings.evidence: load-more-trigger.css:28-30 sets --load-more-accent: var(--a63-action-danger) for data-tone=error; css:93 paints .a63-LoadMoreTrigger-action with it. packages/styles/src/tokens/semantics.css:215 (action-danger = danger-600, no dark override; comment :255-258 says error text uses --a63-text-danger, which moves to danger-400 at :363). danger-600 rgb(187,29,34) vs n1-dark-1 rgb(17,17,17) = 2.95:1, vs n1-dark-2 rgb(25,25,25) = 2.78:1 (computed from primitives.css:95,123-124). Themes story renders only the loading state (stories.tsx:87-114), so no dark failed baseline catches it.
findings.fix: Paint the Retry label with --a63-text-danger and the failed icon with --a63-status-danger (as Alert does, alert.css:134-136), and add a dark/4-theme Failed story with a contrast play check like alert.stories.tsx:71-85.

findings.subject: feedback-state

findings.evidence: feedback-state.css:27-29,73-77; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-feedbackstate-themes-chromium-linux.png dark rows; semantics.css:255-259,413.

findings.subject: load-more-trigger
findings.summary: State is settable two ways (state prop vs isLoading/hasMore booleans), the root takes no rest props, and the children path drops the live region.

findings.fix: Deprecate isLoading/hasMore in favour of state; spread remaining div props onto the root; keep role=status/aria-live on the children path too.

findings.subject: load-more-trigger

findings.subject: feedback-state

findings.subject: alert
findings.summary: AlertAction is absolutely positioned against a fixed 72px reserve, so a longer or translated label, or two actions, overlaps the title and description.

findings.fix: Put the action in its own grid column (auto) instead of absolute positioning, or reserve its measured width; add a long-label/CJK story at phone width.

findings.subject: badge

findings.fix: Add max-inline-size: 100%, overflow: hidden and text-overflow: ellipsis on a text wrapper, and a long/CJK story.

findings.subject: badge
